runs.description: Cheap-tier smoke check: claude/haiku reviews gson via pip-local-wheel (Mode A). Exercises the claude runner + pip channel with the lowest-cost model. Permissive gate_result expect.
Mid-tier: claude/sonnet reviews Express via npm-local-tgz (Mode A). Exercises the claude runner + npm channel — different repo + different channel + different tier from row 1.
Top-tier: claude/opus reviews Ory Keto via pip-local-wheel (Mode A). Largest repo in the matrix; capable model exercises the full pipeline against a complex Go codebase.

Copilot capable on pip-local-wheel: gpt-5.4 reviews Express. First of the two copilot runs designed to exercise pool=2. Validates 145 witness fallback + 148 install.log banner fallback in production conditions.

Copilot capable on npm-local-tgz: gpt-5.4 reviews chi. Second of the two copilot runs — same model + different channel + different repo from the previous row. With pool=2, this and the previous row should run concurrently — pins 125's per-runner concurrency cap.
